notes.title: Patch 1.3 is live now!
notes.notes:
Pilots!

Today is a big day for Kamikaze Lassplanes. The game has just been released on the Japanese eShop and is now available for Japanese players on Nintendo Switch! We're continuing to work on making it available in other regions, but to celebrate today's launch, we've prepared a major update for you.

We’re constantly working on bringing the game to as many languages as possible, and we’re happy to announce that Kamikaze Lassplanes is now available in Simplified Chinese! We hope that this update will allow Alba and Hanna’s adventure to reach a brand-new audience of players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44059914/2b8521b344344f68b83000cead77fd6aec64a4d6.png

At the same time, we’ve introduced a new feature designed especially for our Streamer community.
By enabling the Streamer Mode option in the settings menu, you can now stream the game on even the most restrictive platforms without any issues! Streamer Mode activates a more SFW version of the game’s illustrations.

Additionally, the patch fixes several issues related to the other language versions of the game and includes small tweaks to further improve Kamikaze Lassplanes.

As always, we look forward to your feedback and comments!

Thank you for playing!
Inky Dreams Crew

1.3 Changelog:

⚒ Improvements
- Simplified Chinese added as a language option;
- Streamer Mode added

⚒ Bugfixes
- Fixed language-related bugs;
- Addressed several minor bugs
